title: Ru'ya ta Yohanna ta sake rubuta wani alkawari
intro: Ka yi tunanin an ba ka wani muhimmin mutum, sannan ka fuskanci umarni wanda zai kawo ƙarshen haɗin kai don biyayya. Wani wahayi ya sake fasalin gida gaba ɗaya, kuma sunan da ke tsakiyar umarnin ba a taɓa yin magana da shi ba.
clues: Na tsaya a inda dole ne aminci ya zama dole ga biyayyar Allah.
An san ni a gidan Manzo a matsayin ɗa da aka rene shi.
Na fahimci cewa aurena ya zama batun wahayi da aka yi wa Manzon Allah.
Na ji kalmomin nan, 'Ka kiyaye matarka ka ji tsoron Allah,' an nuna mini.
Sai na fahimci cewa Allah ya umurci Manzon Allah da ya saki wasu mata, kuma aurena dole ne ya ƙare a ƙarƙashin wannan umarnin.
Ni ne Zaidu bn Harithah, ɗan reno mai suna a cikin Suratul Ahzb.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An gaya masa ya riƙe matarsa ​​sannan aka umarce shi ya sake ta
A jefa shi cikin tanderu mai zafi
Barci a cikin kogo tsawon ƙarni da yawa
trial.answer: An gaya masa ya riƙe matarsa ​​sannan aka umarce shi ya sake ta

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya bi umarnin, ya saki matarsa, aka raba auren.
An ceto shi ba tare da wata matsala ba daga tanderu mai zafi
An ceto shi bayan babban kifi ya haɗiye shi
An ba shi lambu mai maɓuɓɓugan ruwa guda biyu
An ba shi iko a kan Gabas da Yamma
outcome.answer: Ya bi umarnin, ya saki matarsa, aka raba auren.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
